name: Albufeira
title: Holidays in Albufeira
intro: The Algarve's liveliest resort, with golden cliffs, sandy coves and a whitewashed old town above the beach. Here's what Albufeira is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: White houses of Albufeira old town on the cliff above the beach
facts_note: Faro airport is about 40 minutes away by road. The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May, June, September and October are the best months: warm and sunny, with fewer crowds than July and August. The Atlantic stays cool even in summer, peaking around 21°C. Winter is mild, with sunny days near 17°C, good for walking and golf.

things.name: Praia dos Pescadores
things.blurb: The main town beach, right below the old town, with fishing boats at one end.

things.name: Old town
things.blurb: Whitewashed lanes, little squares and seafood restaurants on the hill.

things.name: Praia da Falésia
things.blurb: Kilometres of sand under red and orange cliffs, east of town.

things.name: Benagil cave
things.blurb: Boat trips from Albufeira visit the famous sea cave and hidden coves.

things.name: Zoomarine
things.blurb: A marine park with shows, rides and pools, ten minutes away.

things.name: Lagos and Ponta da Piedade
things.blurb: Rock arches and sea stacks along the coast to the west.

faqs.question: Is Albufeira good for a beach holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are over 20 beaches nearby, from the busy town beach to quieter coves like Praia da Coelha.

faqs.question: Is Albufeira lively?
faqs.answer: The Strip in Areias de São João is very lively at night. The old town and resorts like Galé and Olhos de Água are calmer.

faqs.question: How far is Albufeira from Faro airport?
faqs.answer: About 40 kilometres, which is 30 to 40 minutes by car or transfer.

faqs.question: Is the sea warm in Albufeira?
faqs.answer: It's the Atlantic, so it's cooler than the Mediterranean, around 20 to 21°C in August and September.
